$comment: Output map: which columns an output receives, read from the item. Template kind: output-map. "from" is an SI field, record.<name> (a value of the item), or a system token ($run_id, $run_time, $row_hash, $changed_at, $const:<value>). "op" is from the closed output operation set. Customer overrides: outputs/<id>.custom.json (add, remove or rename columns; a column keeps its place unless moved).
description: ServiceNow remediation tasks (Import Set): one row per CI and task to perform -- the update, the software upgrade (per version; a library bundled in another product: per application, with its paths), the configuration change -- with its counts, highest severity and risk, the CI's owner and department, and its state run to run (open / closed and why). Raw lines, never summarised. The SQL hand-off view snowstage.vImportRemediationTask carries the same columns, the same row hash and source run. Every date UTC 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' (the vulnerable items' format); u_si_cleared names the columns now empty (a reopened task: u_close_reason, u_closed_at); u_source_run = 'si-<collection id>-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>', at most 28 characters. Key u_si_task_id. Column names are a contract; append only.
